AUM namaste'stu BagavannArAyaRa vAsudevAdipuruza mahApuruza mahAnuBAva paramamaNgala paramakalyARa paramakAruRika kevala jagadADAra lokEkanATa sarveSvara lakzmInATa paramahaMsaparivrAjakEH parameRAtmayogasamADinA pariBAvitaparisPuwapAramahaMsyaDarmeRodGAwitatamaHkapAwadvAre citte'pAvfta Atmaloke svayamupalabDanijasuKAnuBavo BavAn
